description.value: Departure Bay Pizza is a local pizza shop in north Nanaimo serving a full menu of specialty and custom pizzas, appetizers, pasta, salads, and desserts. The shop offers both online ordering and in-store pickup, with a fresh-slices window available during the day. It sits on Departure Bay Road, a corridor that touring cyclists arriving via the Departure Bay ferry terminal frequently travel.

address.value: 4186 Departure Bay Rd, Nanaimo, BC V9T4B7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at departurebaypizza.com confirms this is a real, operating pizza restaurant with a Nanaimo location at 4186 Departure Bay Rd. The OSM phone number (+1 2505852939) matches the website's +1 250-585-2939. The website shows a 'Pick Up Specials' menu category and the Parksville sister-location page says 'Please call or visit us in store,' confirming takeout is available; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
